artworks.title: Ma femme est-elle a la maison?
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting on a stairway. The image shows a person with a broom or mop standing at the bottom of a staircase, addressing another person who is ascending the stairs. The person on the stairs is dressed in a formal coat and top hat, gripping the handrail, and appears to be frowning or looking disgruntled. The person at the bottom appears to be wearing a headscarf and apron, and might be in a pose of speaking or calling out. The drawing is in black and white, with detailed shading to suggest volume and texture, capturing the moment between the two characters.

artworks.title: Mais quand je vous dis que je ne peux pas remuer les pieds...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene with two figures in an interior setting. The drawing depicts two men engaged in a conversation in a room. One man stands on the left holding a piece of cloth while the other faces him, gesturing. They are dressed in 19th-century attire. The room is furnished with a couch, and there are objects on the floor that resemble slippers or discarded items. The walls have two framed pictures and a decorative clock. The drawing is in a monochrome style using dark lines and shading for texture and depth. The focus is on the moment of interaction with expressive body language and the interior setting.

artworks.title: Inconvénient d'un parapluie a ressorts trop compliqués
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals walking closely together. The man is holding an open umbrella, while the woman is holding her dress with one hand and the man's arm or shoulder with the other. The man has distinct facial features and a top hat covering part of his hair. The woman has a bonnet covering most of her hair. The man is wearing a dark coat and trousers, and the woman is wearing a long, textured garment. Raindrops are visible around them, indicating inclement weather. The background includes vertical lines and shapes suggesting a city building or wall, with cobbled pavement under their feet. The image has a monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: Ah! docteur... je crois... que j'suis poitrinaire!
artworks.description: The image shows two men. One is seated, appearing relaxed, wearing a nightcap, a loose nightgown with vertical stripes, and is seated comfortably in a chair. The other man stands, leaning slightly forward with one hand on the chair's back. He wears a dark suit, fitted pants, a white shirt, and a high collar, and has short, dark hair. Next to them is a table with a pitcher and cup, while the background features a textured wall.

artworks.title: Un Mari brûlé du feu de la jalousie
artworks.description: This drawing shows an individual submerged in water beneath a tree, with a couple standing on a hill in the background. In the foreground, a person is partially submerged in water, clinging to a large tree trunk amidst the watery landscape. The water is depicted with rippling lines, and vegetation surrounds the edges. A top hat floats nearby. In the background, on an elevated hill, a couple is shown embracing or possibly dancing, partially obscured by atmospheric clouds. The scene conveys a sense of drama and contrasts the struggle in the foreground with the serene moment on the hill. The use of monochromatic tones creates a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: C'est t'y a vous c'hien la?
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a park. One person is standing wearing a cloak and hat, holding out an object with multiple legs. The other person is seated on a bench, looking surprised and dressed in layered clothing. The background shows stylized trees. The artwork uses line and shading to create depth.

artworks.title: Les Temps sont durs...
artworks.description: The image shows two men walking side by side, engaged in conversation. The man on the left has short, curly hair, raised brows, and a faint smile. He wears a double-breasted coat and holds a cane. The man on the right wears a suit with a waistcoat, has one hand in his pocket, and wears a top hat. The background features a simple sketch of a landscape with hills or dunes.

artworks.title: Le Plus farceur de la société
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person standing in front of a group of people who are pointing and gesturing. The central figure is holding a bottle and appears animated. The group on the right side is seated and engaged with the central figure. The background is textured with trees, creating a natural setting. The drawing portrays a moment of social interaction using precise linework and shading to convey emotion.

artworks.title: Moi aussi j'ai été jeune...
artworks.description: The image shows a person leaning over a balcony railing, with their upper body bent forward and resting on their forearms. The person has dark hair, a prominent nose, and furrowed brows. They are wearing dark, loose-fitting clothing. Below the balcony, two figures are walking away on a street. One wears a long coat and tall hat, while the other has their head covered with a possible bonnet. The background features an urban setting with multi-story buildings, chimneys, and a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Les Trois petits saints
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three anthropomorphic figures walking down a city street. The characters have exaggerated features and are wearing formal attire. They are articulated with dark, sketchy lines and display expressions of sorrow. The background shows a gathered crowd and high-rise buildings on either side, with some trees and flags.

artworks.title: Les Trois petits saints
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three anthropomorphic figures walking in a procession. The figures have exaggerated features, elongated faces, and wear formal attire. A crowd of similarly dressed figures is in the background. The setting is an urban street with indistinct architecture. The drawing is monochromatic with detailed shading.

artworks.title: (Le Domestique) - Monsieur ferait bien...
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the knees up. The first man on the left is standing with a slight lean, facing towards the right, and holding a dark coat or cloak. He has short, dark hair and angular facial features. He wears a light-colored shirt and striped trousers. The second man, on the right, stands facing the first man with his body slightly turned towards the viewer. He has a fuller face with glasses perched on his nose, and his hair is tousled. He wears a light-colored shirt with a scarf around his neck and similarly striped trousers. The background is a shaded, monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: Une Leçon de botanique
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene with three figures walking. Two are moving left while one is walking to the right. The first figure on the left is an adult man wearing a long coat and a high hat, carrying an umbrella. Beside him is a child wearing a dark jacket and light pants, also with a hat. The third figure is walking to the right, carrying a large object resembling an oversized apple on his back, using a stick for support. The background shows tall buildings on a cobblestone street with some indistinct outlines of objects and people in the distance.

artworks.title: A Naples - Le meilleur des rois... (1st plate)
artworks.description: This is an image depicting a detailed perspective of a figure in elaborate attire standing on a balcony overlooking a street filled with debris. The urban setting includes buildings lining the street extending into the distance. The road below is littered with indistinct shapes resembling debris or fallen objects. The sky features subtle cloud formations and a mountainous horizon in the backdrop, hinting at a wider landscape beyond the city. The composition conveys a mix of drama and grandeur.

artworks.title: Le Commerce un jour d'échéance
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature with four figures visible. The primary figure in the foreground is a man captured from a side perspective, entering a building. His entire body is visible, wearing a simple, wrapped garment resembling a cloak or blanket, with one knee raised as if in motion. His face is not fully visible, but his head is covered with a cloth-plumed hat, and he wears tattered shoes. Behind him stands another figure with a rotund body, exaggerated facial features, and a top hat. This figure appears to be mid-gesture, watching the man in the foreground. Further behind them, two other figures can be seen, walking together. One of these figures wears glasses and a small top hat, with a shorter stature and pointed chin, while the other has a slightly hunched posture. The scene occurs on a city street, with tall buildings indicated by vertical shading in the background. A sign above the entryway reads "Mont de Piété," indicating the location, and suggests a pawnshop setting.

artworks.title: Actionnaires Californiens
artworks.description: This print depicts two people standing and conversing outside. The person on the left is turned to the right with one hand in their pants pocket, wearing a dark jacket and dark vest over a light shirt and light pants. They have short hair, a round, pale face, and are clean-shaven. The person on the right is standing upright, facing the left, wearing a long dark coat over a lighter shirt and gray pants. They have pale skin, short, white hair, and they are holding their hands together in front of them. In the background, there are dark trees and a large building to the right. The sky is a gradient of light gray at the top to white towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Membre... du dix Décembre prenant le la...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in dynamic gestures. One figure is holding a hat high in the air, while the other is grasping a small object. The setting includes a building with pitched roofs in the background, a table with a wine bottle in the foreground, and a bright circle in the sky. The scene is depicted in monochrome with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Oui, madame Chaboulard... vingt-quatre épiciers... [recto]
artworks.description: The image shows two women standing and facing each other in conversation. The woman on the left wears a bonnet tied under her chin and holds a large, plainly woven basket. The woman on the right also wears a bonnet and is dressed in a long dress with a shawl. She seems to be holding her hands together. Both women appear to be carrying baskets. In the background, there is a shaded doorway on the left and a lighter, possibly wood-paneled wall on the right.

artworks.title: L'Esprit frappeur
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a social gathering. In the foreground, two women are seated, wearing long dresses with patterns. One woman has a bow on her head. Both women have defined facial features. A man stands near them. A crowd of men, visible from the torso up, are dressed in dark suits with white collars and cravats. The background is shaded with textured lines.

artworks.title: (1er Bas Bleu) - Profitons de l'occasion...
artworks.description: The image shows three people standing on a wooden floor. The person on the left has curly hair, wears glasses, a long gown, and a shawl. The individual in the middle has dark hair in a bun, wearing a light gown with exposed back. The person on the right wears a bonnet, a dark dress, and a light apron. In the background, there is a framed picture on the wall, paneling, and a door.

artworks.title: L'Inconvénient d'avoir un ami mélomane
artworks.description: The image displays two men standing in an indoor setting, depicted in a caricature style. Both men stand side by side, with one man leaning slightly backward with his mouth open and holding an open book, while the other man stands upright with his hands behind his back. They are in a simple interior with a textured background.

artworks.title: Le Jour de l'an
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing on a cobblestone street. The person on the left has white hair peeking from beneath a tall, dark top hat and is wearing a long dark coat with matching trousers and boots, holding onto a stringed instrument. The figure on the right has dark, tousled hair and a haggard face, wearing a light-colored shirt under a vest with an apron tied at the waist over trousers and worn shoes. The background includes a building wall with a partially visible window and door, bearing the letters "CONCI." Both individuals face each other as if engaged in conversation. The style of the image is monochrome and illustrative.

artworks.title: C'est bête d'avoir en hiver, des...
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a person bending down to interact with two smaller figures on a cobblestone street. In the background, there is a tall building. The illustration uses fine cross-hatching techniques to create texture and shadow. The hats are adorned with flowers and the clothing is detailed, giving it a period feel. There are shadowy buildings with subtle signage visible. The drawing conveys a sense of narrative and character engagement, with a somber mood conveyed through the monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Une Promenade conjugale
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures. One person, a man, is reclining on the ground with his legs bent at the knees and hands behind his head, looking up towards the person standing. He has short, light-colored hair and is wearing a patterned vest over a collared shirt with light-colored pants and dark shoes. Nearby lies a hat. The other person, a woman, is standing beside him holding an open parasol above her head. She has long, flowing hair partially covered by a scarf or veil, and her facial features are gently drawn with closed eyes. She wears a long, flowing dress with a fitted bodice and puffed sleeves, layered with what appears to be a shawl. In her other hand, she holds a small bouquet of flowers. The background depicts a gentle landscape with sparse trees and an open, lightly shaded sky.
